 Summary Statement
 Obligation to provide a confidential report has been met and all initial reporting and compliance measures have been taken to comply with the Conflict of Interest Act .
 Agreed Compliance Measures
 Conflict of interest screens are preventive compliance measures, agreed upon pursuant to section 29 of the Conflict of Interest Act (Act) by a public office holder and the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, to assist public office holders in avoiding conflicts of interest. Screens also seek to minimize the possibility of conflicts arising between the public duties of the public office holder and their private interests or those of their relatives and friends. 
The Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and I have agreed that a conflict of interest screen is an appropriate compliance measure for me, aimed at preventing any opportunity, while I exercise my official powers, duties and functions as a reporting public office holder, to further the private interests of my relative, Don Moors, Partner with Partner of Temple Scott Associates or to give preferential treatment to Temple Scott Associates on the basis of the identity of Mr. Moors. 
Accordingly, I have agreed to abstain from any discussion, decision, debate or vote in relation to Temple Scott Associates. I also agree not to have any communication with government officials in relation to any matter or decision-making processes involving my relative’s interests.
This screen is administered by the Associate Secretary of the Treasury Board to ensure that I am neither made aware of nor participate in any official matters or decisions-making processes involving my relative’s private interests, unless their interest in the decision or matter is of general application. 
The President of the Treasury Board, the Privy Council Office, the Prime Minister’s Office, direct reports, the members of my staff and all other necessary colleagues and public servants have been informed in writing about this conflict of interest screen.
I have undertaken to inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner at the earliest opportunity of all changes of which I become aware that relate to or should form part of the above list of matters caught by this screen.
If I am made aware of a matter forming part of this screen or any such matter comes before me, I am required under section 21 of the Act to recuse myself from that matter. I must so inform the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner and, where appropriate, make a public declaration of recusal pursuant to subsection 25(1) of the Act.
 Recusal
 In the exercise of my official duties on July 6 and on July 15, 2015, I recused myself from participating in any discussion and/or decision involving the University of Ottawa Institute for Mental Health Research in order to avoid the opportunity to improperly further their private interest or the appearance of giving preferential treatment to the Institute
 In the exercise of my official duties on June 5 and on June 11, 2015, I recused myself from participating in any discussion and/or decision involving the University of Ottawa Institute for Mental Health Research in order to avoid the opportunity to improperly further their private interest or the appearance of giving preferential treatment to the Institute
